scenarios.title: Ordering at a café
scenarios.setting: A busy neighborhood café in the morning.
scenarios.goal: Order a drink and something to eat, then ask how much it costs.

scenarios.title: At the market
scenarios.setting: An outdoor market stall with fruit and vegetables.
scenarios.goal: Buy three kinds of fruit, ask for a price per kilo, and pay.

scenarios.title: Meeting a new neighbor
scenarios.setting: The hallway of an apartment building.
scenarios.goal: Introduce yourself, say where you are from, and ask one question back.

scenarios.title: Asking for directions
scenarios.setting: A street corner near the train station.
scenarios.goal: Ask how to get to the museum and repeat the directions back.

scenarios.title: At the pharmacy
scenarios.setting: A small pharmacy; you have a sore throat.
scenarios.goal: Describe how you feel, ask what to take, and how often.

scenarios.title: Lost luggage
scenarios.setting: The baggage desk at an airport.
scenarios.goal: Report a missing suitcase, describe it, and give a hotel address.

scenarios.title: Booking a table
scenarios.setting: A phone call to a popular restaurant.
scenarios.goal: Book a table for four on Friday evening and ask about a vegetarian dish.

scenarios.title: Checking in at a hotel
scenarios.setting: The front desk of a small hotel.
scenarios.goal: Check in, ask about breakfast times, and request a quiet room.

scenarios.title: At the doctor's
scenarios.setting: A doctor's office; you hurt your ankle two days ago.
scenarios.goal: Explain what happened, answer questions, and understand the advice.

scenarios.title: Returning a faulty item
scenarios.setting: An electronics shop; the headphones you bought stopped working.
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem politely and ask for a refund or an exchange.
